name: cloudtalk
description: Run every call from your AI assistant. CloudTalk is the agent-first phone system: AI agents answer first, humans close. Starts with a guided tour, then finds open loops after your calls, picks your next best calls, coaches your team and AI Voice Agents, and builds and tests AI Voice Agents.

api_key.title: CloudTalk API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty and sign in with CloudTalk instead. Only for an API key connection to the AI Voice Agent tools: paste the base64 of API_KEY_ID:API_KEY_SECRET from Dashboard > Account > Settings > API keys. Build it with: echo -n "API_KEY_ID:API_KEY_SECRET" | base64
